title: Ungahlanganisa Kanjani I-SRD R370 Grant Yakho
description: Kungani i-SASSA icela abathengi be-SRD ukuthi bahlanganise izicelo zabo, izinyathelo zokuhlanganisa ezijwayelekile ku-srd.sassa.gov.za ne-WhatsApp, isikhathi sokugcina ukuze ungulahlekelwe inyanga yokukhokhelwa, nokwenzeka uma ungakwenzi.

seo.metaTitle: Ungahlanganisa Kanjani I-SRD R370 Grant Yakho (2026 Ngezinyathelo)
seo.metaDescription: Hlanganisa isicelo sakho se-SRD R370: nini i-SASSA iyadinga, izinyathelo ze-portal ne-WhatsApp, izikhathi zokugcina zanyanga, nemiphumela yokungahlanganisi.

contentBlocks.title: Ungahlanganisa Kanjani I-SRD R370 Grant Yakho
contentBlocks.description: I-SASSA icela abathengi njalo ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yabo isacoleka ngaphambi kwenkathi yokukhokhelwa elandelayo. Uhlelo ukuthi ukudubula kunokubuyisa — lokhu ukuthi ungahlanganisa kanjani ngezinyathelo ezimbalwa.

contentBlocks.text: Ukuthi ukuhlanganisa yini (noba nini kuba yizicelo)

Ukuhlanganisa yini ukuthi i-SASSA ikucele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yakho, inombolo yocingo, nezimo zokufaneleka zingashintshanga ngemva kwemvume yakho yokugcina. Kuyaqalwa ukusuka ekuseshweni kwedatha ngesikhathi — ikakhulukazi ngemva kokuguquka kwezinqubomgomo noma uma ifayili lakho libe liphuzile ngesikhathi esithile.
Isicelo siyeza nge-SMS ezivamile ze-SASSA. Ngoba abakhiphi bezintambo balo mlo, qalisa njalo ngewebhusayithi esemthethweni kunokusebenzisa izihlanganisi zemiyalezo.

steps.title: Vula ku-srd.sassa.gov.za
steps.description: Sebenzisa ifoni yakho noma eyedlela ethembekile. Iwethi isebza kunoma yisiphi isiphequluli sefoni.

steps.title: Khetha 'Qinisekisa isicelo sakho' / ukhetho lokuhlanganisa
steps.description: Ivela ohlwini lwamasevisi ekhasini lokuqala uma isikhathi sokuqinisekisa sivuliwe.

steps.title: Faka inombolo yakho ye-ID nenombolo yocingo
steps.description: Lezi zimali kufanele zihambisane nezokuthi i-SASSA ezinayo — bheka uhlobo lwethu lokushintsha inombolo uma lezi zihlukile.

steps.title: Bheka Yonke Imibhalo
steps.description: Qinisekisa ukuthi usahlangabezana nezigaba zemali, awutholi imali ye-UIF/NSFAS, nokuthi imininingwane yakho isacoleka.

steps.title: Thumela bese ugcina inombolo yokubhekelela
steps.description: Uthola i-SMS yoqinisekiso uma sekuqediwe — ngokuvamile kungakapheli izinsuku.

contentBlocks.text: Uthanda i-WhatsApp? Thumela ku-082 046 8553 uthi 'Hlanganisa'. Imenyu ikhombisa imibhalo efanayo usebenzisa inombolo yakho ye-ID. Isikhungo (0800 60 10 11) nalo singakusiza uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela kumadatha.

Isikhathi sokuhlanganisa sivala ngaphambi kokulandelayo kwemvume yenyanga. Uma i-SMS yakho inesikhathi sokugcina — ngokuvamile siyasondele ekupheleni kwenyanga — qeda ukuhlanganisa kamuva ngangokunokwenzeka ngaphambi kwaso. Izicelo ezingagcwali isikhathi azikhokhelwa enyanga leyo; ukuzigcwalisa kamuva kubuyisela izinyanga ezizayo kodwa kuvamise ukungabuyiseli eyedlule.

contentBlocks.title: Okwenzeka uma ungahlanganisi
contentBlocks.text: Isimo sakho siyashintsha kube 'siphelelwe yisikhathi' noma 'singapheleli', izinkokhelo zima, futhi kungase kudingeke ubeke isicelo esisha esikhundleni sokusebenzisa nje ukuqinisekisa. Imizuzu embalwa yokuhlanganisa igcina inyanga yemali.
Uma ukuhlanganisa kungasebenzi noma kungamukela imininingwane yakho

Izizathu ezivamile kakhulu yilezi: inombolo yocingo eshintshe, iphutha le-ID, noma ifayili elibonakaliswe ngokuhlola. Lungisa imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana kuqala, bese uzama futhi emva kwamahora angu-24. Ukuhluleka okuqhubekayo kusho ukuthi kukhona kufayili lakho okudinga ukunakwa ngumuntu — vakashela isikhungo ngasinye se-SASSA nekhadi le-ID eluhlaza noma i-smart card yakho.
Ungakhokhi muntu ophakathi ukulungisa ifayili ephelile. Wonke amakhono okubuyisela asebenza ngamadoda amahhala, futhi abaphathi ezikhungweni basebenza nezifayili eziphelile njalo.

faqs.question: Ngiyihlanganisa kanjani i-SRD grant yami?
faqs.answer: Yiya ku-srd.sassa.gov.za, khetha ukhetho lokuhlanganisa, fake i-ID ne-inombolo yocingo ebhalisiwe, bheka imibhalo yokufaneleka, bese uthumela. Ungasebenzisa ne-WhatsApp 082 046 8553 noma usho ku-0800 60 10 11.

faqs.question: Kungani i-SASSA icela ukuthi ngihlanganise ngesikhathi esithile?
faqs.answer: Ukuhlola ngesikhathi kusho ukuthi izimo zakho zingashintshanga futhi imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana isasebenza. Lokhu yindlela i-grant eqhubeka ngayo ngaphandle kokuvakashela ezikhungweni minyaka yonke bonke abantu.

faqs.question: Ngilahlekelwe isikhathi sokugcina. Ngiyakuthola yini inyanga leyo?
faqs.answer: Ngokuvamile cha — izikhathi ezilahlekile azivamisi ukubuyiselwa. Qeda ukuhlanganisa manje noma kunjalo ukuze izinyanga ezizayo ziyaqhubeka, bese ukhala kuphela uma i-SMS yakho ikhombisa ukuthi isaziso sakho asifikanga.

faqs.question: Ukuhlanganisa yini okufanayo nokukhala kwanyanga eyaliwe?
faqs.answer: Cha. Ukuhlanganisa kugcina isicelo esamukelwe siphilile. Ukukhala kuhlolisa inyanga ethile eyaliwe ngokumelene ne-trabho eyinhloko — inqubo eyodwa enesikhathi sayo.

faqs.question: Isimo sami sithi 'siphelelwe yisikhathi'. Ingabe ukuhlanganisa kwanele ukulungisa?
faqs.answer: Uma ukuphela bekusanda kwenzeka futhi kungenxa yokubulala ukuqinisekisa, ukuhlanganisa ngokuvamile kubuyisela ifayili. Izifayili eziphelile kade zidinga isicelo esisha — hlola ikhasi lesimo lakho ukuze ubone yini ehambelana.

faqs.question: Ukuhlanganisa kuhamba nangamali?
faqs.answer: Cha. Noma yimuphi umuntu noma iwebhusayithi ethola imali yokuhlanganisa iyakhipha ubugebengu. Sebenzisa ku-srd.sassa.gov.za kuphela, i-WhatsApp line, isikhungo, noma izikhungo eziphakanyisiwe.
